response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong distributed systems and Linux exposure, but his recent and dominant expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js/web platforms rather than modern C++ or Rust, and he has no demonstrated experience with routing tiles, navigation guidance, or geospatial data pipelines beyond a hobby GIS web app built with JS/D. His C++ experience is limited to a brief 2014-2015 role and a college project, far short of the senior-level modern C++/Rust engineering this role requires.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering background across web, embedded, and systems roles
Some geospatial/GIS domain familiarity via personal GISCollective project
Experience with distributed, high-throughput microservice systems (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
concerns: Minimal recent hands-on C++ experience (last significant use ~2014-2015) and no Rust experience
No direct experience with routing tiles, navigation guidance systems, or map data pipelines at production scale
Current and recent roles are heavily TypeScript/Node.js focused, a mismatch with the C++/Rust systems focus of this role

key_factors.factor: Lack of modern C++/Rust production experience
Strong general distributed systems and Linux background
